newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia's Tatarstan sees $200 mln Eurobond-Interfax.
newsitem.headline: Russia's Tatarstan sees $200 mln Eurobond-Interfax.

text.p: Russia's Tatarstan republic plans to raise $200 million in a Eurobond issue, Interfax news agency quoted Tatarstan Deputy Finance Minister Rinat Gubaidullin as saying on Thursday.
The Tatar government is now in talks with potential lead-managers and rating agencies for the issue, scheduled for the start of 1998.
The Tatarstan republic is one of many Russian cities and regions, including Irkutsk and Nizhny Novgorod regions and the cities St Petersburg and Moscow, which are planning Eurobond issues.
